description_en: Queries slow query log entries for a MongoDB instance
description_zh: 查询MongoDB实例运行出现的慢日志明细
name: DescribeSlowLogRecords

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

If you set this parameter to the ID of a sharded cluster instance, you must also specify the `NodeId` parameter
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。 
如果是分片集群实例，您还需要配置`NodeId`
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the shard node.

This parameter is required only when you specify the `DBInstanceId` parameter to the ID of a sharded cluster instance
parameters.help_zh:
Shard节点ID。 

如果`DBInstanceId`配置的是分片集群实例的ID，需要配置该参数
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.



The end time must be later than the start time.

The end time must be within 24 hours from the start time. Otherwise, the query fails
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 必须晚于查询开始时间。 查询结束时间距查询开始时间不得超过24个小时，超过则调用失败
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The keywords used for query. You can enter up to 10 keywords at a time. If you enter multiple keywords, separate the keywords with spaces
parameters.help_zh: 查询关键字，多个关键字以空格分隔，不超过10个关键字
parameters.name: query_keywords

parameters.help_en:
The logical relationship among multiple keywords.

or

and (default value)
parameters.help_zh: 关键字搜索的逻辑操作， 默认值为and
parameters.name: logical_operator

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 30 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，取值范围为30~100。
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the INTEGER data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The order of time in which the log entries to return are sorted. Valid values:

asc: The log entries are sorted by time in ascending order.

desc: The log entries are sorted by time in descending order
parameters.help_zh:
按时间的升降序对查询到的慢日志进行排序。取值如下：
asc：按时间升序排序。
desc：按时间降序排序
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the instances you want to query belong
parameters.name: resource_group_id

Engine.description_zh: 当前数据库的引擎类型

LogRecords.description_en: An array that consists of the information about each slow query

AccountName.description_en: The username of the database account that performs the operation
AccountName.description_zh: 执行该操作的数据库用户名

DocsExamined.description_en: The number of documents that are scanned during the operation
DocsExamined.description_zh: 该操作执行时扫描的文档数

ExecutionStartTime.description_en: The start time of the operation. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
ExecutionStartTime.description_zh: 操作执行的开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

HostAddress.description_en: The host IP address that is used to connect to the database
HostAddress.description_zh: 连接数据库的主机地址

KeysExamined.description_en: The number of rows involved in index scans

QueryTimes.description_en: The execution time of the statement. Unit: milliseconds
QueryTimes.description_zh: 该语句的执行时长，单位为毫秒

ReturnRowCounts.description_en: The number of rows returned by the SQL statement

SQLText.description_en: The SQL statement that is executed during the slow operation

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page. The value is a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the INTEGER data type. Default value: 1
PageNumber.description_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of slow query log entries returned on the page
PageRecordCount.description_zh: 本页慢操作日志明细的个数

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of returned entries
